scope: Actual production app.js/core.mjs in Node VM; DOM, HTTP and RTC are explicit test doubles. No browser rendering, decoded media or native input execution.

tests.name: cancellation during discovery aborts before authentication or redemption
cancellation during proof verification never sends the code or PIN
a canceled one-use POST settles only to close its known late session
an uncertain POST failure is not retried and never exposes transport details
a malformed or escalated grant is closed without displaying a desktop
pending sessions expose no peer or input and repeated disconnect is idempotent
input requires the actual app peer, channel, catalog, permission and fresh frame
fresh video without a primary-display catalog cannot authorize input
page hide releases held input, closes once, and requests a keepalive end
focus or visibility loss releases keys and hidden pages cannot send input
permission removal immediately gates input and later restoration ends the session
a changed host identity ends the active session instead of reusing its peer
a delayed old stop failure cannot overwrite the result of a newer attempt
unsupported fullscreen is an actionable message rather than an uncaught exception
agent connection binds the permanent PC ID and labels itself before first-frame admission
agent image tokens authorize one action and never replay across fresh input
agent input rejects stale observations even when newly arriving video is fresh
agent can observe a viewer session but cannot inject any input
agent actions are bounded and release a complete key combination
disconnect during an agent redemption waits to end the known late session
